assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12: 'Affected version range | versions prior to the fix (imprecise -- no exact threshold in Jira description)'. assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 22-36: OSV.dev API source URL shown as 'https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901'. Parsed field 'Fixed | 0.4.8'. Line 36 states: 'The OSV record explicitly lists "fixed": "0.4.8" in its SEMVER range events.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md lines 46-51: 'Cross-Validation Result: AGREEMENT' with 'MITRE and OSV.dev agree on the fix threshold: 0.4.8'. Lines 56-58 set enriched fix threshold to 0.4.8 from 'MITRE CVE API + OSV.dev (cross-validated)'. Line 62 explicitly states: 'This enriched fix threshold (< 0.4.8) supersedes the imprecise Jira description data and will be used for all version impact comparisons in Step 2.3.'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md line 5: 'Using the cross-validated fix threshold from Step 1.5: h2 < 0.4.8 (affected), >= 0.4.8 (not affected).'
